instruction: Set the default comment for GIMP images to 'Created with GIMP'.

metadata.explanation: Task requires user to navigate to GIMP preferences and set the default comment for images to 'Created with GIMP'. The evaluator checks the gimprc config file for 'default-comment "Created with GIMP"'. Uses existing check_config_status metric and get_gimp_config_file getter.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: 1.0 if default-comment is set to 'Created with GIMP', 0.0 otherwise

llm_judge_reasons: Critical parsing logic error: check_config_status splits on whitespace which breaks multi-word quoted strings
Expected value contains spaces: '"Created with GIMP"' will be parsed incorrectly
The parsing logic (line split()) will produce: ['default-comment', '"Created', 'with', 'GIMP"']
items[-1] will be 'GIMP"' instead of the full expected value '"Created with GIMP"'
Evaluator will always fail even when user correctly sets the config value
The gimprc format stores values as: (default-comment "Created with GIMP") which requires proper quoted string parsing
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Fix check_config_status to properly handle quoted strings with spaces (use regex or shlex.split() instead of str.split())
Alternative: Change expected value to use the actual tokens after parsing, or parse the line differently to preserve quoted strings
Consider using a proper S-expression parser for gimprc files which use Lisp-style syntax
Test the parsing logic with actual gimprc file format: (key "multi word value")
